in_marathi.name: Nidhaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nidhaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nidhaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nidhana' which means 'treasure' or 'wealth'. This name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in life.
